localCarryForward.scope: Local source-only work preserved in place and excluded from B3 PR. These are local inventory strings, not links or required documentation dependencies. No files were moved or deleted.

measurements.axisOrder: Parent-radial, orbital, spin-pole directions in the interpreted model; inertial attitude unresolved.

model.qualification: Source-constrained envelope, not a released shape solution or measured neck. Center of volume, not measured center of mass; shadowed neck/depth and unseen terrain remain unknown.

sourceMeaning.radiometry: Partially processed DN/s, not I/F or natural color. Primary, independent error and unsigned quality arrays remain separate.
sourceMeaning.validity: Finite primary values with quality flag zero are eligible, including valid negative values. Intensity is not the quality mask.
sourceMeaning.coordinates: 1024x1024 stored pixel centers, zero-based. Archive display is bottom-to-top; FITS CRPIX is converted from one-based. WCS is third-order TAN-SIP in ICRS; quaternion is instrument-to-J2000.
sourceMeaning.timing: Header mid-exposure UTC/TDB is retained independently from the acquisition filename clock. No undocumented timing correction is accepted.

cameraDiagnostics.qualification: Approximate visible centers are hand-read diagnostics, not accepted fit controls. Matching WCS/quaternion boresights confirms conventions only, not pointing accuracy.

pointingRoute.finding: Published DLR photogrammetry fits sightlines to Dinkinesh silhouettes before adjustment. The required corrected cameras have not been acquired/validated for these exact original frames.
pointingRoute.unqualifiedDiagnostic: Approximate parent recentering gives about3.16km separation and5.5m ray mismatch; hand-selected centers and unresolved roll make it a route to fitting, not an accepted state or registration.

rejectedShortcut: dinkinesh_v10.tpc explicitly labels its pole coordinates as placeholders and describes the parent, not Selam. It cannot supply a measured Selam attitude.

historicalSourceTests.scope: Prior bounded source/model tests only; not rerun as a B3 deliverable or counted in Callisto tests. No body bake or browser qualification.
